review_type: AI methodological cross-check; not human validation or an independent source-extraction round
methodological_disposition: The proposed descriptive analysis is consistent with the ratified core if the conditions below are retained. No new population decision or human adjudication is required for these arithmetic operations.

primary_estimand.unit: One independently randomized trial population; N=28 for each applicable reference/component/modality combination.
primary_estimand.groups: Four reference definitions multiplied by seven applicable component/modality combinations = 28 separately presented primary rows. The 224 mortality-derivation/ideation-or-attempt cells are inapplicable and excluded, not unknown.
primary_estimand.complete_categories: Direct complete and derived complete are mutually exclusive source-scoped cell classifications. Report both, together with bounded not-complete and unknown, so C_direct+C_derived+B+U=N.
primary_estimand.conditional_identification_interval: [C/N, (C+U)/N], conditional on this explicitly enumerated core, the archived current source scope, the reference and classifications. It is not a confidence interval or a probability of clinical suicide. It does not incorporate misclassification, unidentified studies or perfect clinical ascertainment.
primary_estimand.rounding: Compute with integer counts before rounding percentages for display. Preserve exact count numerators and denominator.
primary_estimand.no_sampling_inference: No p-values, binomial confidence intervals, programme superiority claims or random-effects meta-analysis are justified by this finite retrospectively delimited documentary census.

critical_input_observation.interpretation: All applicable cells are complete or unknown. Accordingly, every primary identification interval and the proposed union/subset/withdrawal sensitivity intervals have an upper endpoint of 100%. This is a substantive result of conservative documentary coding, not a numerical error. Confirmed counts establish lower bounds only; these data do not demonstrate that most trials are non-reconstructible. These position totals are QA diagnostics, not independent trial totals or a pooled scientific percentage.

secondary_union.rule: Within one unit, reference and component: complete if any applicable modality is complete; otherwise unknown if any is unknown; otherwise bounded not-complete only if all applicable modalities are bounded not-complete.
secondary_union.proof_type: A union with at least one direct complete witness can be labeled direct-supported. A union with no direct complete witness but at least one derived witness is derived-only. Report any overlap separately if desired; never sum modality counts as unique trials.
secondary_union.scope_limit: For source-defined safety and on-treatment references, the union means a complete witness exists in at least one admissible explicitly stated source population/window. It does not establish completeness of all source variants, a common time horizon across modalities or clinical interchangeability of the modalities.

sensitivities.rule: In a separate scenario copy, replace a complete-derived cell with unknown/withheld-derived-proof, leaving all original direct, unknown and bounded not-complete cells untouched. Then apply the normal union rule.
sensitivities.interpretation: This measures how much confirmation relies on derivation. It is not a new source classification or a demonstrated absence of direct reporting. Keep original unknowns distinguishable from scenario-withheld positives in audit tables.

sensitivities.rule: Recompute unions using adverse-event reports and structured assessments only. Derived AE witnesses remain admitted unless a separately named derivation-withdrawal scenario is applied.
sensitivities.interpretation: Do not describe this as excluding all derivations. No death-to-ideation/attempt conversion or denominator change is permitted.

sensitivities.status: Defensible compositional sensitivity, explicitly post-hoc operationalization
sensitivities.rule: Select the 24 records without membership_amendment in the frozen core; retain their current 11-Nov classifications. Do not recode any outcome or revive an older source version.
sensitivities.interpretation: This is a subset analysis omitting the four author-ratified population amendments, not a finding that they are ineligible and not a reconstruction of an original pre-results analysis. The four remain included in the ratified primary N=28 core.

sensitivities.rule: Repeat the same counts and conditional intervals within strata or after omitting one programme, never weighting by participants or pooling effects.
sensitivities.interpretation: Differences can reflect source windows, trial era, ascertainment, document availability and review intensity. They do not estimate drug safety differences or comparative reporting quality uncontaminated by those factors.

sensitivities.status: Defensible secondary change of counting unit, not the primary estimand
sensitivities.rule: Map the 28 populations to their 27 NCTs using the frozen core. Within one NCT/reference/component/modality require every independently randomized population to be complete. All complete gives complete; any bounded not-complete gives bounded not-complete; otherwise an unknown gives unknown. Retain the GPI1/GPI2 individual records.
sensitivities.secondary_union_order: For a secondary registry-level any-modality result, first obtain each population's any-modality union, then require all populations in the NCT complete. Label this explicitly: the two populations may have complete witnesses from different modalities. This is not equivalent to requiring one common modality to be complete across both populations.
sensitivities.proof_type: A fully complete registry is entirely direct-supported only if each required population has a direct witness. If any necessary population relies only on derivation, label the registry derivation-dependent; do not call mixed provenance purely derived.
sensitivities.interpretation: Only SURMOUNT-OSA has two populations under one NCT. Requiring both is stricter than an any-population rule. Do not merge arm participant counts or pretend there are 27 independently randomized populations.

source_and_reference_limits: The current dataset is one cumulative source scope at 11 November 2026. Do not reconstruct historical A-B3 layers by inferring admissibility from source type or an undated file.
Do not aggregate the four reference profiles as 112 independent trials; their differences are population/window changes within the same 28 trial populations.

Reference contrasts may include changes in treatment attribution, assessed versus nominal denominator, window and source. Any transition matrices are descriptive and not causal gains from extra sources.
Retain participant counts, recurrent event counts, positive visits and patient-years separately. The documentary statistics count trial populations, not patients, events or risk estimates.
Historical 182/159 analyses remain separate dated comparators; differences from the new core cannot be attributed to one factor without a dedicated matched decomposition.

The current technical judgments were AI-assisted and reuse earlier human decisions within their actual scope. Computational replication does not establish new independent human extraction or validate all source interpretations.
recommended_tests: All expected 28x4x3x3 keys occur once, including exactly 224 NA keys; reject duplicate/missing keys and inconsistent status/indicator mappings.
Per applicable row C_direct+C_derived+B+U=N; percentages are based on N, including unknowns.
Union truth table covers C+U => C, B+U => U, B+B => B, and NA never enters an applicable denominator.
Derived-withdrawal preserves base input bytes and replaces derived positives by scenario unknowns, not negatives.
An unknown-only synthetic set has interval [0,1]; all complete [1,1]; all bounded not-complete [0,0].
Registry conjunction covers C+U => U, B+U => B, C+C => C; verify secondary any-modality union order explicitly.
Frozen memberships generate 28 populations, 27 registry IDs, 24 unchanged memberships and correct programme denominators without selection based on completeness.
Independent arithmetic implementation and result-by-result comparison reproduce all primary and secondary rows; preserve frozen input hash.
